question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Fix the boundary conditions
WITH weekly_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT calendar_year, week_number, CAST(week_date AS DATE) as week_date
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
june15_boundary AS (
    SELECT calendar_year,
        (SELECT MAX(week_number) FROM weekly_data w2 WHERE w2.calendar_year = w1.calendar_year AND w2.week_date < DATE(w1.calendar_year || '-06-15')) as last_before_june15,
        (SELECT MIN(week_number) FROM weekly_data w2 WHERE w2.calendar_year = w1.calendar_year AND w2.week_date > DATE(w1.calendar_year || '-06-15')) as first_after_june15
    FROM weekly_data w1
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
labeled_data AS (
    SELECT c.calendar_year, c.week_number, c.week_date, c.week_date_formatted, c.sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.week_number >= j.first_after_june15 AND c.week_number <= j.first_after_june15 + 3 THEN 'post'
            WHEN c.week_number <= j.last_before_june15 AND c.week_number >= j.last_before_june15 - 3 THEN 'pre'
            ELSE 'other'
        END as period
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales c
    JOIN june15_boundary j ON c.calendar_year = j.calendar_year
    WHERE c.calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as total_sales_pre,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as total_sales_post,
    ROUND(1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN sales ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM labeled_data
WHERE period IN ('pre', 'post')
GROUP BY calendar_year
ORDER BY calendar_year

    FROM weekly_data w1
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
-- Assign pre/post labels based on distance from June 15
labeled_data AS (
    SELECT c.calendar_year, c.week_number, c.week_date, c.week_date_formatted, c.sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.week_number > j.first_after_june15 AND c.week_number <= j.first_after_june15 + 3 THEN 'post'
            WHEN c.week_number < j.last_before_june15 AND c.week_number >= j.last_before_june15 - 3 THEN 'pre'

    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales c
    JOIN june15_boundary j ON c.calendar_year = j.calendar_year
    WHERE c.calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
)

    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as total_sales_post,
    ROUND(1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN sales ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as pct_change

GROUP BY calendar_year

FROM labeled_data
